leadText: Okuni (Japanese: オクニ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Okuni (Japanese: オクニ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==
 , Magoichi, Okuni, Tadakatsu, Kanetsugu, Yukimura, Gracia, and Hanbei]]
 
In , Okuni assists Nō in her battle against the Hero/Heroine in Spectra.

In her story, , Nō chooses Okuni to represent Spectra. However, Okuni only agrees to participate after she hears that many great, male Warriors are participating.

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 65% link with Larvesta or Volcarona.

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Please wake up..."
With low health or a status ailment: 
"Hmm, this isn't looking so good."
When victory is near:
"Now we're getting there!"
Otherwise:
"Away we go!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"This is my time to shine!"
When defending a castle: 
"Troublemakers always get taken down!"

During battle: 
"What? What is it, ? Hey, hey, you're right! That one over there is really quite handsome, isn't he..."

When ordering to attack: 
"How about trying ?"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"Are there any cuties lurking around here, I wonder?"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Best foot forward!"

Upon forming a link: 
"Oh, , you're such a cutie! You're coming with me!"

When she has formed a Perfect Link:
" ... You know, something about being with you just feels different—special even... Do you feel it too? I think I could do a pretty good job with you by my side, !"

When using an item: 
"My might work."

When using her Warrior Skill: 
"It's time to brighten things up!"

After winning a battle: 
If she attacked a castle:
"Bye! Take care now!"
If she defended a castle:
"Bye! Come again, won't you!"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"What a splendid fighter you are! I'm ever so impressed..."
When defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Oh! What happened there?"
Otherwise:
"How could you be so cruel to my poor little ?"

When being recruited:
"Ah, would you let me come along with you? Only if it's okay with you, of course..."

When there are 30 Warriors in the army:
"Oh wow, look how many allies we have now! The Pokémon seem delighted as well!"

===Profile===
Energetic and lighthearted, she is forever taking off at a drop of a hat and can be found in all four corners of Ransei.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Okuni debuted in PNA4.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Okuni has the lowest Capacity of any Warlord.

===Historical origin===
Okuni is based on the real-life of Japanese history. She is credited as being the founder of theater.
